ACCESS-01.gap: Apply local accessibility requirements. Test loaded movements, obstacle response and egress on fitted equipment and the surveyed platform.
ACCESS-01.match: Platform sweeps and the fitted-train review expose nominal clearances and items awaiting evidence. Boarding permissions are exercised by the station bench.
ACCESS-01.objective: Review door permissives, movement clearances and accessibility across the complete train-platform interface.
ACCESS-01.risk: Passengers can be trapped, encounter an excessive boarding gap or be exposed to movement.
ACCESS-01.scope: Baghdad fitted-vehicle and prototype platform interface studies
ACCESS-01.subject: Boarding and door interfaces

ASSET-01.gap: Agree asset-management objectives, owner responsibilities, maintenance intervals and as-installed information. Demonstrate the process on operator records.
ASSET-01.match: The pilot demonstrates serial history. The corrected cost study identifies renewal scope and the timing of owner costs.
ASSET-01.objective: Keep the installed serial, maintenance history and lifecycle obligations accessible to the operator.
ASSET-01.risk: An asset loses its identity or its required inspection, replacement or renewal funding.
ASSET-01.scope: ERPNext maintenance pilot and revised Baghdad Airport cost study
ASSET-01.subject: Asset history and renewal

BIM-01.gap: Set information requirements and validation rules. Verify the required IFC edition, exchange view and as-built handover with the recipient.
BIM-01.match: The twin register identifies candidates, occurrence counts and export hashes. The showcased IFC4 exports are an exchange example within the ISO 16739 standards family.
BIM-01.objective: Exchange a model with identifiable occurrences, source revisions and a declared information scope.
BIM-01.risk: The buyer or maintainer imports the wrong model revision or misreads its quantities.
BIM-01.scope: Operator review IFC4 model examples, each on its registered candidate
BIM-01.subject: Information handover and IFC exchange

CIV-01.gap: Select the local structural basis, applicable action and material codes and National Annex. Verify geotechnical conditions, fatigue, detailed prestress and lift conditions.
CIV-01.match: The family comparison tests span alternatives, vehicle loading, foundation assumptions and erection scope.
CIV-01.objective: Carry governing loads and working-life assumptions into structural checks and construction methods.
CIV-01.risk: A girder, bearing, foundation or temporary lift fails under the governing site or train load.
CIV-01.scope: Baghdad viaduct family and erection comparison
CIV-01.subject: Structural verification and erection

LAB-01.gap: Agree methods, uncertainty and acceptance limits. Obtain authenticated results for the exact article from a laboratory with the required scope.
LAB-01.match: The bench procedure and ERPNext qualification gate specify evidence intake and reviewer responsibilities.
LAB-01.objective: Record the tested article, approved method and limit, instrument calibration and raw results.
LAB-01.risk: A replay or measurement is attributed to the wrong article, instrument or test boundary.
LAB-01.scope: Baghdad station bench and first-article qualification preparation
LAB-01.subject: Test evidence and calibration

POWER-01.gap: Obtain source and fault data. Verify earthing, return paths, touch voltage, protective clearing, isolation and emergency access at site.
POWER-01.match: The audit maps outages to service and collects equipment return data. The voltage screen covers collectors, with electrical safety evidence still due.
POWER-01.objective: Identify the live paths, protection interfaces and evidence needed to isolate and maintain the railway.
POWER-01.risk: An isolated section remains energised or access exposes people to hazardous touch voltage.
POWER-01.scope: Revised Baghdad Airport paired-feed and radial traction studies
POWER-01.subject: Traction power isolation and return

QMS-01.gap: Audit actual supplier controls, competence, special processes, nonconformance and production records. Agree how the railway standard's dated ISO 9001 reference applies.
QMS-01.match: Factory routes, matched enquiry issues and the ERPNext handoff specify evidence for supplier comparisons, work orders and inspection.
QMS-01.objective: Carry quantity, revision, ownership and inspection points from the enquiry into purchasing and production.
QMS-01.risk: An offer, manufactured part or inspection record applies to a different design issue.
QMS-01.scope: Baghdad first-article planning and corrected supplier enquiry
QMS-01.subject: Supplier, manufacturing and inspection records

RAMS-01.gap: Set project RAMS targets and hazard ownership. Allocate safety and integrity requirements and review accepted residual risk for the installed system.
RAMS-01.match: Requirement policy and the Airport register distinguish obligations, assumptions and evidence holds. The verification record identifies the inputs evaluated.
RAMS-01.objective: Carry an identified system, operating conditions, requirements and open risks into each design decision.
RAMS-01.owner: System integrator and independent safety assessor
RAMS-01.risk: Scope or a design change invalidates an earlier safety or operating assumption.
RAMS-01.scope: Shared selection method and revised Baghdad Airport study
RAMS-01.subject: Railway lifecycle and hazards

SIG-01.gap: Measure target hardware timing, position and brake feedback. Exercise loss of authority, degraded operations, rescue and evacuation with the operator.
SIG-01.match: The station bench specifies signals and fault cases. Its trace tests cover replay validation with simulated inputs.
SIG-01.objective: Verify the station cycle and degraded responses across train and wayside boundaries.
SIG-01.owner: Train control integrator and independent safety assessor
SIG-01.risk: A train moves while passengers are boarding or after trusted feedback is lost.
SIG-01.scope: Baghdad powered-wheel station controls and software bench
SIG-01.subject: Train protection and command/control

SW-01.gap: Agree the applicable software route, software requirements and integrity allocation. Review independence, tool and target baselines and hardware-in-the-loop records.
SW-01.match: Crate boundaries and pinned dependencies identify the software scope. Source-level and CI checks exercise software contracts.
SW-01.objective: Tie verification to source, tests and the deployed configuration.
SW-01.risk: A changed binary or configuration invalidates tested interlocks.
SW-01.scope: Current Rust ATP, TCMS and door software
SW-01.subject: Safety-related software lifecycle
